name: Ahmed ElSamman
tagline: I build frontend experiences that make complex products easier to use.
status: Open to frontend opportunities · Full-time / Remote / Relocation
shortBio: I'm Ahmed ElSamman, a frontend engineer focused on Angular, React, and TypeScript. I build production-oriented web experiences for enterprise learning platforms, industrial operations, and customer-facing products — with an emphasis on maintainable architecture, responsive interfaces, and Arabic/English RTL support.

identityNarrative.heading: Engineering beyond the screen
identityNarrative.body: I enjoy turning complex product requirements into interfaces teams can evolve confidently. My work spans feature architecture, reusable components, API integration, real-time workflows, SSR, performance, and accessible user experiences.

identityNarrative.heading: Enterprise thinking, product detail
identityNarrative.body: At Medica Scope, I work on multi-tenant learning experiences within an Angular and Nx environment. Alongside that, I build industrial monitoring interfaces and independent products that solve practical problems, from driver profitability to personal productivity.

identityNarrative.heading: A collaborative engineer
identityNarrative.body: I collaborate across frontend, backend, and product/UX work, and bring a teaching mindset from my ITI experience. I value clear communication, thoughtful code reviews, and technical decisions that make the next change easier.

achievements: Building multi-tenant LMS experiences with Angular, Nx, SSR, and real-time workflows.
Developing industrial monitoring interfaces for machines, sensor data, and production operations.
Creating independent products including MIRHAL and Ehsebha, spanning frontend architecture and API integration.
